final: WITH standings_deltas AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.year, r.round, c.country, ds.driverId, ds.wins - COALESCE(LAG(ds.wins) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, ds.driverId ORDER BY r.round), 0) AS wins_gained FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), race_means AS (SELECT country, raceId, AVG(wins_gained) AS race_avg FROM standings_deltas GROUP BY country, raceId), country_means AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_avg) AS country_avg FROM race_means GROUP BY country), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(country_avg) AS overall_avg FROM country_means), first_kept AS (SELECT cm.country, cm.country_avg, b.overall_avg FROM country_means cm CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE cm.country_avg > b.overall_avg), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(country_avg) AS avg_kept FROM first_kept) SELECT fk.country, fk.country_avg AS average, fk.country_avg - fk.overall_avg AS above_overall_benchmark, fk.country_avg - sm.avg_kept AS above_second_mean FROM first_kept fk CROSS JOIN second_mean sm WHERE fk.country_avg > sm.avg_kept
